data.assumption: “EMI share by acquiring bank in India last month” means the count share of successful non-test payment attempts in August 2026 where emi_tenure_months is present, grouped by acquiring bank for Indian showrooms.
data.sql:
SELECT
  pa.acquiring_bank,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.emi_tenure_months IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
WHERE pa.is_test = false
  AND o.is_test = false
  AND c.name = 'India'
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND pa.status = 'success'
GROUP BY pa.acquiring_bank
